rationale: dual_domain_n2i-claude-agentic: train_n=200, val_n=4, batch_size=1, grad_clip=1.0, seed=1337, warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=8, n_iter=400, outer_wall_s=1500, lr=0.0003, unet_c=16, rationale=iter-9 ONE-KNOB CEILING-CONFIRMATION PROBE: random seed 42->1337, ALL OTHER KNOBS held at the iter-7 WINNING baseline (lr=3e-4, pretrain_epochs=8, n_iter=400, unet_c=16, val_n=4, grad_clip=1.0, outer_wall_s=1500). FAILURE MODE (per-image U-Net N2I converged on Mayo's 2304-view substrate): across iters 1-8 every CAPACITY/BUDGET/REGULARIZATION lever is now exhausted -- (a) n_iter 400->800: 0.9501->0.9508 marginal, budget SATURATED (iters 1-2); (b) unet_c 16->32 is DEAD on BOTH operating points -- flat at lr=1e-3 (iter-3 0.9508->0.9502) AND flat/regress under the anchored regime (iter-8 c=32 -> 0.9543 < the 0.9562 winner); (c) per-scan lr LOCALIZED, 3e-4 is the bracketed sweet spot (iter-4 0.9541 beats 1e-3 above @iter-1 0.9501 and 1e-4 below @iter-5 0.9479 which over-anchors); (d) warm-start pretrain_epochs DIMINISHING/saturating (3->6 +0.0017 iter-6, 6->8 +0.0004 iter-7). Best = iter-7 0.9562; the recent iter-6/7/8 spread is only 0.9558-0.9562 (delta ~0.0004), suspiciously close to run-to-run noise. HYPOTHESIS (ceiling-is-the-noise-floor): this is a CEILING-CONFIRMATION probe on the UNTRIED seed axis -- not a knob expected to climb. The per-scan Adam fit has stochastic init (warm-start U-Net weights) + stochastic angular-subset/minibatch order, all keyed off cfg['seed']. Changing seed 42->1337 with EVERYTHING else fixed measures the solver's run-to-run variance directly. If val lands within ~+/-0.001 of 0.9562, it CONFIRMS dual_domain_n2i has converged to its ~0.956 per-image U-Net ceiling on Mayo and that the iter-6/7 'gains' (+0.0004/epoch) are inside the noise band -- documenting WHY the ceiling holds (the recent climb was anchor-quality noise, not real headroom). If instead val swings >0.001, it quantifies the variance floor and tells iters 10-20 the honest error bar on every reported number. Either outcome is a clean ceiling read. EXACTLY ONE knob changes (seed); lr/pretrain/n_iter/unet_c/val_n/grad_clip ALL held at the iter-7 winner. WALL <=15 min: identical step count to iter-7 (unet_c=16, n_iter=400, val_n=4) which ran ~792-909s; outer_wall_s=1500 caps it. grad_clip=1.0 mandatory (2304-view FBP adjoint overflows otherwise). Converging to the ~0.956 per-image ceiling toward iter-20. DO NOT revert to amortized; per-image N2I rewrite (commit 1f4c3394).
